bill.title: Requires use of uniform campus climate survey by institutions of higher education.

action.description: Reported and Referred to Assembly Appropriations Committee

posted_text:
🌎 Environment & Climate
NJ A5597 — NJ Colleges to Use Same Survey to Track Campus Safety

New Jersey colleges will now be required to use a standardized survey to assess campus climate related to sexual assault and misconduct. The Secretary of Higher Education will develop and oversee the use of this uniform survey, which will collect data on student experiences, attitudes, and institutional responses. ...
